title.subtitle: - An adventure across the wilderness to power up your motivation to learn -
title.credit: Lead researcher Yunho Kim · Co-researcher Seonghye Moon

dialog.hint: Tap the screen or press Space

demo.n1: An adventure across the wilderness. The travelers are walking toward the Land of Dreams.
demo.angel1: Hi! I'm Sparkle, the starlight spirit who woke up inside the Golden Compass!
demo.angel2: See the cloud and the firelight far ahead? They'll light our way. Let's go to the Land of Dreams together!
demo.partyI: It's way more fun when we all go together!
demo.partyS: Slow and steady, so nobody gets hurt~
demo.partyC: Route calculated. We're good to go.
demo.n2: Just then, something came slinking out of the sand.
demo.devil1: Sssso~ why walk through this hot wilderness? Let's rest here for just 5 minutes~
demo.devilRest: Hehe, 5 minutes turns into 50 before you know it~
demo.angelRest: Rest is important too! But let's decide how many minutes first. Then Slinky can't beat us!
demo.devilGo: Hmph… next time I'll get you for sure!
demo.angelGo: Awesome! You just beat a temptation. Confidence gauge UP!
demo.mamba1: I am the Black Mamba! I'm the one who gets in the way of your dreams and studies!
demo.angel3: Know yourself and know your enemy, and you'll win every battle! Next stage, let's find your Black Mamba!
demo.clearSub: The next stage is on its way
